an3.155:1.1: Ye hi bhikkhave sattā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti, vācāya sucaritaṃ caranti, manasā sucaritaṃ caranti supubbaṇho bhikkhave tesaṃ sattānaṃ,
an3.155:2.1: ye bhikkhave majjhantikasamayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti . . . pe . . . manasā sucaritaṃ caranti sumajjhantiko bhikkhave tesaṃ sattānaṃ,
an3.155:3.1: ye bhikkhave sattā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti . . . pe . . . manasā sucaritaṃ caranti susāyaṇho bhikkhave tesaṃ sattānan ti.
an3.155:4.1: Sunakkhattaṃ sumaṅgalaṃ suppabhātaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ Sukhaṇo sumuhutto ca suyiṭṭhaṃ brahmacārisu
an3.155:5.1: Padakkhiṇaṃ kāyakammaṃ vācākammaṃ padakkhiṇaṃ Padakkhiṇaṃ manokammaṃ paṇidhīyo padakkhiṇā Padakkhiṇāni katvāna labhat' atthe padakkhiṇe
an3.155:6.1: Te atthaladdhā sukhitā virūḷhā buddhasāsane Ārogā sukhitā hotha saha sabbehi ñātibhī ti. Maṅgalavaggo pañcamo.
